items.label: Asked how it started — the cold, then the second-night bark
Asked about fever — cool, unlike the mimic
Asked if she is drinking — no drool, no statue-child
Graded her from the doorway, hands off
Neck film — the steeple, and a clean epiglottis
Dexamethasone given — the whole visit in one syrup
…and given before the stridor came to rest
The safety-net speech, said back word for word
An hour of watching before the door
Ordered nothing this mild croup did not need
